description: RAPID/Collaborative Research: Japan-U.S. Collaboration on the Seismic Resilience of Wood-frame Building Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Maria Koliou, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). This project presents the application of modern survey techniques in collecting damage data of full-scale shake table tests in order to preserve their time-sensitive outcomes for future researchers. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Shake Table test, Wood buildings, restoration, resilience. Published 2022-09-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
